- Fixed an issue where Scores could be added to the wrong Scoreboard.

[h1]Sound[/h1]
- Captain Kikki will now respect the Mute option.  
[b][i]We had a serious talk with him[/i][/b]

[h1][b]Gladiators! The first FREE DLC: BLOOD BRAWL has been released alongside Patch v.1.3![/b][/h1]

- Fixed an issue where Luna Stormare could not heal Hardy Klanning with Hux Flux while Warmachine was active.

notes.title: Bloodsports.TV Patch Notes v1.2 (30474)
notes.notes:
[h1]Gladiators![/h1]
[b]A new patch is live![/b]
This one will focus primarily on fixing issues.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[b]- Hardy Klanning’s Warmachine Tech Power scaling removed so that he can no longer be invulnerable.[/b]
Even tanks can die now ːcuteː

[b]- Hardy Klanning’s Warmachine crowd control immunity should now work a lot better.[/b]

[b]- Hardy Klanning’s Mortal Strike should now properly scale with Tech Power.[/b]
Call it compensation.

[b]- Buzzer Ingholm’s Acid Rain ability tooltip will now display the correct Tech Power scaling.[/b]

[b]- Buzzer Ingholm’s Rigged Decoy and Acid Rain kills now triggers “On Kill” effects.[/b]

[b]- Lil’ Erik’s Unstable Mutation self-inflicting damage halved to match the ability tooltip.[/b]
Sorry 'bout that one Erik

[b]- Fixed an issue where a combination of Lil’ Erik’s Unstable Mutation and 12” Spike Guards could injure Gladiators trying to heal Lil’ Erik.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where Gunvald the Mad could get stuck in his Deathmark animation.[/b]

[b]- The Old Moose’s abilities and attacks will now work a lot better.[/b]

[b]- Cerebral Overcharger stacks now grant 5 health per stack as stated in the item tooltip, instead of 1.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where Energy Tap would not trigger correctly at high attack speeds again Energy Tapped targets.[/b]

[b]- Item and ability cooldowns should no longer reset on death.[/b]

[b]- Medikus Path to Glory Achievement “I'm not a scientist” should now give correct amount of Tech Power.[/b]


[h1]UI[/h1]
[b]- Added borderless fullscreen option to video settings.[/b]

[b]- Locked skins can now be previewed in the lobby even if not unlocked through the Path to Glory.[/b]

[b]- You can now use the right mouse button to buy items in the shop with one click.[/b]

[b]- The Scoreboard will now default to showing ‘Top Players’ instead of ‘Find Me’ if you have no scores in the chosen scoreboard.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where the team overview could stop updating player gold values.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where leveling an ability while being dead could show the wrong mana cost and showing abilities as available even though they were not.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where the “Lock Camera on Gladiator” toggle button sometimes showed as not locked when it actually was.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where the lobby chat text sometimes became green.[/b]

[b]- Added a pop up message for when a server fails to be hosted due to no connection to the Steam Servers service.[/b]

[b]- Fixed various typos. [/b]

[h1]Tech[/h1]
[b]- Fixed issue where Gladiators could be revived with too much health depending on what items they owned.[/b]

[b]- Fixed crash when pressing escape key while rebinding a key ingame.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where Gladiators could be knock backed through walls (they can still dash through them with abilities).[/b]

notes.title: Bloodsports.TV Patch Notes v1.1 (30342)
notes.notes:
[h1]Gladiators![/h1]
A new patch is live for Bloodsports.TV!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[b]- The guaranteed crit buffs granted by True Horror and Vengeful AI Buckler now last for one normal attack or up to 3 seconds.[/b]
[i]Now infinitely shorter.[/i]

[b]- Hardy’s Seismic Stomp can no longer damage the Missile Silo.[/b]
[i]It was kind of funny though ːcuteː[/i]

[h1]Tech[/h1]
[b]- Enemy pathfinding should work better on Rooftop Rumble.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where the Mad Butcher would teleport outside the gameplay area.[/b]

[b]- Wave number should now longer get messed up when a new player joins the game after wave 10.[/b]

[b]- Fixed crash when buying both Turbo Energizer and Cerebral Overcharger, and then selling one of them.[/b]

[b]- Fixed crash when using abilities on a Gladiator just being revived.[/b]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[b]- Units killed by the Missile destruction explosion should no longer grant coin or experience.[/b]
[i]For more accurate post game stats.[/i]

[b]- Hyland's Hyperfang will no longer give combat text to all players.[/b]

[b]- If all players but one are ready in a game lobby, and the one that is not ready get kicked/leaves the game, the countdown should now start automatically.[/b]

[b]- Wide Search in server filters will now pick up a lot more servers.
For all of you in the remote parts of the world![/b]


[h1]See you in the Arena![/h1]

notes.title: Bloodsports.TV Beta Has Come To An End
notes.notes:
[h1]Gladiators![/h1]

The Bloodsports.TV Beta has come to an end. For the next two days we'll be preparing for the official release on March 30. You can find more information about what this will entail here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/336420/announcements/detail/243532091302525279

During the Beta we've received a ton of great feedback and have been hard at work squashing bugs, polishing features and implementing community ideas such as Smart Cast ːcuteː

We hope you've enjoyed participating in the Beta and would like to thank each and every one of you for your help in making Bloodsports.TV a better game. Special shout-out to those of you who made it to the Top 100 in the Scoreboard - great work!


[h1]So, what's next?[/h1]
Up until launch you can grab the game at a discounted price as well as get a FREE BONUS COPY:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/336420

We have a lot of ideas for things we'd like to do post-launch and we hope you're as excited for the future of the game as we are. If you have ideas for future updates, let us know in the forums!


Gladiators, prepare for the official launch of Bloodsports.TV.
Outlaws are incomingːomfgː

notes.title: Patch Notes: Beta v0.94 (30262)
notes.notes:
[h1]Gladiators! Another patch is coming for the Beta of Bloodsports.TV![/h1]

[b]v0.94 (30262)[/b]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[b]-  Kati Sagan’s abilities should now work a lot better. She will no longer run back to her old attack target when teleporting out of range or chase down targets while Lockdowned.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where ranged Gladiators sometimes would move into melee when attacking.[/b]
Outlaws should be shot on sight - not hugged.

[b]- Fixed an issue where Luna’s Hux Flux only could heal allies and damage Outlaws once every 5 seconds.[/b]
"I feel alive again" one Bruiser is quoted to have said after trying the patch.

[b]- Fixed an issue where Hardy Klanning would sometimes miss targets with his Dauntless Charge.[/b]
He’s just not that acrobatic.

[b]- Beasts respawn delay increased from 5 seconds to 10 seconds. Should improve situations where the Beasts respawned instantly after being killed.[/b]
No more - or at least fewer - sudden ambushes.

[b]- Fixed an issue where some Beasts could not damage BoxBots.[/b]
We'll miss those epic battles of BEAST vs MACHINE, but its for the best!

[b]- Alfred's DynaVisor™ T-30 bomb should now also explode on death. Explosion damage reduced from 1500 + 1000% Tech Power to 1000 + 500% Tech Power.[/b]
Its actually useful now!

[b]- Fixed issue with Turbo Energizer, Grizzly Toothblade and The Windmiller where you could gain the wrong buff depending on in what order you bought the items.[/b]

[h1]Sound[/h1]
[b]- Fixed issue where the commentator would always be disabled until the user changed settings.[/b]
Censorship isn't cool.

[h1]UI[/h1]
[b]- Enemy healing combat text is now green.[/b]
Did you know that the Mad Butcher also heals himself off of your suffering with his Lifesteal Aura?

[b]- Escape key can now be used to abort the chat in game.[/b]

[b]- Score monitor in main menu now supports higher scores and longer names.[/b]
#Firstworldproblems (we're looking at you How4much)

[b]- Added server filters in server list.[/b]
Passworded servers begone!

[b]- Fixed a bug where the shop ‘Buy’ button would toggle between enabled/disabled every time an item is selected in the shop, regardless of if you can afford it or not.[/b]

[h1]Tech[/h1]
[b]-  Fixed crash when entering a game from lobby while game was ending.[/b]

[b]- Fixed crash when trying to reset Path of Glory progress.[/b]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[b]- Updated several tooltips to make descriptions easier to understand.[/b]


See you in the Arena! ːcuteː

notes.title: Patch Notes: Beta v0.93 (30156)
notes.notes:
[h1]Gladiators! We have a new patch life for the Beta of Bloodsports.TV![/h1]

[b]Patch Notes: Beta v0.93 (30156)[/b]


[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[b]- Reduced cooldown of heals at lower ranks: Lisbeth’s Helping Hand from 6/-1 to 4/-0.5, Luna’s Hux Flux from 9/-1.5 to 7/-1 [/b]
Tanks can now expect to live through wave 1 when doing their jobs.

[b]- Alfred's Dynavisor T-30 bomb damage increased from 800 + 1*TP to 1500 + 10*TP.[/b]
Needed a little more bang for the buck.

[b]- Rimfrost AC-2.0’s activated ability should now be instant (had a second delay before triggering) and its activated ability slow reduced from 95% to 85% and radius increased from 5 to 6.[/b]
Winter is coming. Now instantly.

[b]- Fixed issue where Curse Clan Idol and Troll-Rabbit's Foot would not obey their cooldowns.[/b]
Seems to be some sort of jinx on these items.

[b]- Bloating Implant now gives 200 health instead of 250.[/b]

[b]- Edgy Implant now gives 5% Attack Speed instead of 10%.[/b]

[b]- Numbing Implant now gives 5% Armor instead of 10%.[/b]

[b]- Spiky Implant now gives 3% Critical Chance instead of 5%.[/b]

[b]- The Mad Butcher will now teleport more often and be better at picking a good target to teleport to.[/b]
Surprise!

[b]- Slashers will now prioritize attacking Medikus and Regulators a lot more and Slayers slightly more.[/b]
They just look too tasty. Nom!

[h1]Art[/h1]
[b]- Some Bloom tweaking.[/b]
No more occasional light shows. Or at least not as often.

[b]- Updated The Village Hero’s Blast Wave ability feedback, telegraphing that its more dangerous closer to the center.[/b]
Yes. Stay away from the center of the giant explosion.

[b]- Improvised Decoy from IDEA Toolbox’s taunt aura is now blue so it looks less intimidating, it is also double in size to match the radius of the aura.[/b]
No. It is not dangerous for Gladiators.

[b]- Made the teeth on the Missile Shark white.[/b]
Or whale, as some seem to prefer to call it ːcuteː

[h1]UI[/h1]
[b]- Changed ready button to green.[/b]

[b]- Ingame player names now support Cyrillic letters.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue with the loading screen in various resolutions.[/b]

[b]- The health bars and combat text should now scale better to resolution.[/b]

[b]- UI should now work a lot better while the game is minimized.[/b]

[b]- Item cooldown no longer disappear when moving items in the inventory.[/b]

[b]- The Windmiller should now be sorted into the right categories in the shop.[/b]

[b]- Klyve's Man-Cleaver ability now uses the correct effect icon.[/b]

[b]- Having several The Scout's Code should now only give one ːcuteː icon.[/b]

[h1]Tech[/h1]
[b]- Made game a lot more stable while returning back to lobby.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a bug in Path to Glory were challenges sometimes would not unlock when they should after low tier challenges got bugged.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a bug in Path to Glory where the legendary tier challenge for each class could not be unlocked in Endless mode.[/b]

[b]- The hotkey to hide the UI should now work again (Ctrl + G).[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where enemies could sometimes get stuck in the air.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a crash when leaving the game while reviving.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a crash when clicking on the portrait of revived Gladiators.[/b]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[b]- Servers playing on a diffrent version of Bloodsports.TV will no longer be viewable from the server list.[/b]

[b]- Environmental Rats should no longer be able to stop Hyper Discharge projectiles.[/b]
This is not a joke.

[b]- Fixed several spelling errors. [/b]

[b]- Improvised Decoy from IDEA Toolbox’s taunt aura is now blue so it looks less intimidating, it is also double in size to match the radius of the aura.[/b]
No. It is not dangerous for Gladiators.

[b]- Made the teeth on the Missile Shark white.[/b]
Or whale, as some seem to prefer to call it :cute:

[h1]UI[/h1]
[b]- Changed ready button to green.[/b]

[b]- Ingame player names now support Cyrillic letters.[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue with the loading screen in various resolutions.[/b]

[b]- The health bars and combat text should now scale better to resolution.[/b]

[b]- UI should now work a lot better while the game is minimized.[/b]

[b]- Item cooldown no longer disappear when moving items in the inventory.[/b]

[b]- The Windmiller should now be sorted into the right categories in the shop.[/b]

[b]- Klyve's Man-Cleaver ability now uses the correct effect icon.[/b]

[b]- Having several The Scout's Code should now only give one :cute: icon.[/b]

[h1]Tech[/h1]
[b]- Made game a lot more stable while returning back to lobby.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a bug in Path to Glory were challenges sometimes would not unlock when they should after low tier challenges got bugged.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a bug in Path to Glory where the legendary tier challenge for each class could not be unlocked in Endless mode.[/b]

[b]- The hotkey to hide the UI should now work again (Ctrl + G).[/b]

[b]- Fixed an issue where enemies could sometimes get stuck in the air.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a crash when leaving the game while reviving.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a crash when clicking on the portrait of revived Gladiators.[/b]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[b]- Servers playing on a diffrent version of Bloodsports.TV will no longer be viewable from the server list.[/b]

[b]- Environmental Rats should no longer be able to stop Hyper Discharge projectiles.[/b]
This is not a joke.

[b]- Fixed several spelling errors. [/b]

notes.title: Important - Beta Information
notes.notes:
[h1]Gladiators![/h1]

First off we'd like to thank all of you for participating in the beta. While we do a lot of testing within the team and with external testing partners, it is impossible for us to properly simulate thousands of players actually playing the game - so having you all join us in this event is invaluable and greatly appreciated. We've located a number of issues and added some awesome new features like Smart Cast due to popular demand!

If you haven't yet answered the survey, please do! It's great to hear your feedback on all areas of the game and really helps us ensure we're delivering the best game possible. You can find a link from the main menu ingame.


[h1]The Beta will come to an end at 14.00 CDT / 12:00 PDT / 20:00 GMT on [b]March 28[/b] and the game will be unplayable until the official launch on March 30. [/h1]

In preparation for launch, a few things will happen:

[b] - Scoreboard and Path to Glory will be reset[/b]
During the Beta we've noticed a number of issues with players getting stuck in Path to Glory, in order to best fix these for launch we'll need to reset all users to the same save version. It also helps ensure that all players get a fresh start together with the newcomers at launch. 

The Scoreboard will also be reset to start the competition to the top off with a bang. Don't worry though, we'll make sure to archive the top 100 players at www.bloodsports.tv for eternal glory!

[b] - Achievements and Trading Cards will NOT be reset[/b]
You'll get to keep these for release!

[b] - Pre-purchase Offer[/b]
There is currently an issue where users who have already activated the Beta are unable to receive the proper pre-purchase bonus we're offering for the game. Once the beta is over you'll be able to purchase the game at a discounted price and receive a FREE BONUS COPY to send to a friend! ːcuteː
This will only be available during pre-purchase so make sure to snag it before the 30th!

Thanks again for being a part of a fantastic Beta, we hope you'll all celebrate the official launch with us on March 30!

See you on the Arena!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Beta v0.92 (30030)
notes.notes:
[h1]Gladiators! We have a new patch live for the Beta of Bloodsports.TV[/h1]

[b]Patch Notes: Beta v0.92 (30030)[/b]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[b]- Added Smart Cast.[/b]

[i]By public demand.[/i]

[b]- Multiplayer balance tweaks! Health scaling per player for Champions, Beasts and Boxbots reduced from 40% to 30% and damage scaling reduced from 10% to 0%. Henchmen damage scaling reduced from 5% to 0% (and health scaling remaining at 25%). Bosses health and damage scaling unchanged at 50% and 10%.[/b]

[i]We noticed that the games often got harder as more player joined the game, especially when player had not yet mastered their tank/healer roles. The idea it for the game to be equally hard - or if not, easier - as more players join in. It’s a co-op game after all.[/i]

[b]- Score for being killed is now fully refunded when revived (Gladiator death score remains at -100, but revive score increased from +75 to +100).[/b]

[i]You know that friend who always manages to get killed? Just make sure to revive them in time![/i]

[b]- Doubled the coin reward for slaying Beasts.[/b]

[i]Because who doesn't love more money?[/i]

[b]- Brutalizer Ground Slam ability, Hunter Rocket Jump ability and Old Moose Kick ability now applies its stun with a 0.2 seconds delay to prevent it from interrupting the pull/knockback effect.[/b]

[i]Now working as intended.[/i]

[b]- Buzzer’s Hyper Discharge now follows the ground![/b]

[i]Outlaws can no longer use stairs as tactical advantage against Buzzer.[/i]

[b]- Fixed some wrong Grit (enemy effects resistance) values for Path to Glory rewards and abilities. Lisbeth’s Adamantine Field had most issues, increasing the duration of enemy effects by 33% instead of reducing them by 75%.[/b]

[i]Oops.[/i]ːcuteː



[h1]Art[/h1]
[b]- The Mad Butcher’s Acid Bombardment ability now has a pulsating cyst in its AOE effect that pops as the AOE explodes.[/b]

[i]Yuck.[/i]


[h1]UI[/h1]

[b]- There is now a Surrender option in the ingame menu. This ends the game but lets you collect your currently achieved score.[/b]

[i]Sometimes you just know its over..[/i]

[b]- Vamp Strike, Crit Chance, Crit Damage, Deflect and Grit is now shown in player stats UI in the HUD.[/b]

[i]Information, yay![/i]

[b]- Updated and standardized some stats names: ‘Damage’ is now ‘Attack Damage’, all instances of ‘Critical Chance/Damage’ changed to ‘Crit Chance/Damage’ and ‘Stun Resistance’ is now ‘Grit’ (it doesn’t only affect stuns).[/b]

[b]- The effect granted by Solar Collector and B2 Power Rod has been renamed from Solar Collector to Recharge to match the items’ ability name.[/b]

[b]- The Village Hero’s “Village Hero Immortality” ability has been renamed to “Rallying Cry” to better match what it does.[/b]

[i]It didn’t make him immortal...[/i]


[h1]Sound[/h1]
[b]- Fixed a bug where dying would override players’ sound settings.[/b]


[h1]Tech[/h1]
[b]- Fixed issues with multi-hit projectiles (Buzzer’s Hyper Discharge and more) which caused them to not hit all targets in its path when playing at low frame rates.[/b]

[b]- A lot of FPS and Memory optimization.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a crash for when Mayor Havok used his Grenade Rain ability.[/b]

[b]- Fixed a crash when applying graphics settings (and when applying other settings too if it caused graphics settings to be saved).[/b]

[i]Probably the most common crash in the world.[/i]


[h1]Misc[/h1]
[b]- Alt and Ctrl are now reserved for Self Cast and Level Up abilities and will automatically follow any changes in hotkeys.[/b]

[b]- Game should now attempt to prevent the chat from opening while using Alt + Enter.[/b]

[i]Game is now 12% less annoying.[/i]

[b]- Numpad enter should now also work for the lobby chat.[/b]

[i]That's another 3%![/i]

[b]- Added additional safety checks for resetting player progress from Settings menu.[/b]

[i]Can also be used if you just wanna experience the Path to Glory again![/i]


See you in the Arena!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Beta v0.91 (29857)
notes.notes:
Beta v0.91 (29857)

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Normal (7 waves) and Long (10 waves) game lengths are now unlocked from start rather than being unlocked from Path to Glory. Default game length on install is now 10 waves.[/b]
[i]It's just more fun this way.[/i]
[*][b]Delay between waves increased by 15 seconds. it is now 60 seconds for “normal” waves and 75 seconds for boss waves. Note that this delay is scaled with Leagues.[/b]
[i]More time for shopping![/i]
[*][b]Swift Vengeance achievement requirement lowered from 2500 vengeance kills to 250 vengeance kills.[/b]
[i]You could say we made Vengeance even Swifter..[/i]
[*][b]Mad Butcher ability ‘Osmosis Aura’ renamed ‘Life Drain Aura’ and particles color changed to red rather than green and life drain beam particles are now larger. Life Drain Aura now also deals more damage (up from 10% max health damage in all Leagues to 15-25% based on League ability scaling). The Mad Butcher’s speed while in Life Drain Aura now also scales more with League ability scaling, making it actually faster in master League and up, rather than slower (up from 80-100% speed to 80-160%).[/b]
[i]Turns out nobody understood the word "Osmosis", so we made it look and sound more dangerous. Crowd Control is now more effective in higher leagues.[/i]
[*][b]Enemy Champions health scaling per wave decreased from 30% to 25% while health scaling cap wave increased from wave 10 to wave 15.[/b]
[i]Enemy champions could get really grindy to kill at mid-late waves (~8-10), especially if lacking a proper single target damage dealer, while waves 10+ sometimes got very easy to kill fast with high damage oriented teams. This change should mitigate this, while also making it slightly easier to complete 10 waves in all Leagues.[/i]
[*][b]Damage over time effects no longer proc Vamp Strike.[/b]
[i]Bleed and Vamp was just too good. Sorry.[/i]
[*][b] “Buzzer” Ingholm Power Shot [Q] active charge up reduced from 0.5 seconds to 0.25.[/b]
[i]Because it should stun the enemy, not the player[/i]
[*][b]Quick Fix removed.[/b]
[i]Was made redundant a while back, nobody was buying them[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Art[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Replaced the missile model with a brand new "Sharksplosive"[/b]
[*][b]Hover highlights now also highlight hovered units’ weapons.[/b]
[*][b]Added bloom.[/b]
[*][b]Major particle effects update, both new effects added (primarily for activated items) and changes to existing ones.[/b]
[*][b]Color and lighting tweaks to several levels.[/b]
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Game font now supports Cyrillic letters.[/b]
[*][b]Game chat now works in the end game screen.[/b]
[i]For gg’s, wp’s etc.[/i]
[*][b]Updates to picture-in-picture and tutorial text messages.[/b]
[*][b]Hovering a Gladiator’s portrait in the HUD now highlights that Gladiator and the cursor updates correctly when doing so, no longer always showing as ‘unable’.[/b]
[*][b]Multiplayer’ renamed to ‘Play’ and ‘Host’ renamed to ‘New Game’, ‘Lone Wolf’ renamed to ‘Tutorial’ and now only includes the Tutorial level.[/b]
[i]It is still possible to play alone by reducing the player limit or setting a password for you Lone Wolves out there[/i]
[*][b]League selection list now displays the enemy stun resistance increase for the Leagues.[/b]
[i]Stun resistance reduces the duration of stuns and other crowd control effects.[/i]
[*][b]Added a ‘Reset save’ to game options for if progression issues with Path to Glory occurs or if you just want to go through it again.[/b]
[*][b]Fixed various issues with the Scoreboards.[/b]
[*][b]Path to Glory achievement descriptions are now colored based on their class affiliation.[/b]
[i]To make it clearer that each path is associated with each of the classes.[/i]
[*][b]Standardized all instances for the ingame currency to “coin”.[/b]
[*][b]Beasts name updates: “Wolf” renamed to “Wasteland Hound”, “Bear” renamed “Corrupted Bear” and “Big Boar” renamed “Alpha Boar”.[/b]
[*][b]Numpad ‘Enter’ can now also be used as ‘Enter’ in the chat.[/b]
[*][b]Hide UI (Ctrl + G) is now available during Free Flight camera (F10, toggle).[/b]
[i]For taking awesome screenshots or making crazy videos.[/i]
[/list]
[h1]Sound[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Updates and timing tweaks to various sounds.[/b]
[/list]
[h1]Tech[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed various bugs and crashes.[/b]
[*][b]Updates to how several transporter abilities and effects work, making things like True Horror more reliable and jumping enemies stunned or killed mid-air to follow their ongoing transporter through. Charge transporters are still interrupted by stuns.[/b]
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
ːcuteː Updated credits. ːcuteː

notes.title: Bloodsports.TV Looks Like Borderlands vs Smash TV
notes.notes:
Not every RPG has to be a roguelite now, y’know. Sometimes it’s nice to kill and kill and kill without having to overly worry about getting killed. The hyper-violent Bloodsports.TV is the toon-styled sequel to post-apocalyptic Diablolike Krater, whose setting made it catnip to Jim back in 2012, but he came away feeling let down. The unpleasantly-named (at least, if like me, you grew up in an area mostly populated by wealthy farmers who positively revelled in vulpine slaughter) Bloodsports.TV is an amped-up sequel/spin-off which appears to borrow liberally from Borderlands’ aesthetic. The manic tone too, it seems. Will this a more characterful ARPG make?
